## Why This Is Asked
This probes SwiftUI basics, Codable persistence, MapKit integration, and accessibility with a practical location-tagged notes app.

- Codable persistence to local JSON in Documents
- SwiftUI Map annotations and list synchronization
- Location permissions UX and graceful failure modes

## Code Example
```swift
struct Note: Codable {
    let id: UUID
    let text: String
    let date: Date
    let latitude: Double
    let longitude: Double
}
```
```swift
func save(notes: [Note]) {
    let url = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0].appendingPathComponent("TrailNotes.json")
    let data = try! JSONEncoder().encode(notes)
    try! data.write(to: url)
}
```
